intro: The story behind Premier Salon and what you can expect in the chair.aaaaa
paragraph1: Premier Salon has built its name the old way — one good cut at a time, and a lot of people coming back. We keep the shop small on purpose, so every client gets full attention, not a rushed ten minutes between appointments.
paragraph2: If you're new to Bonner Springs or just haven't found your regular spot yet, come sit down. We'll figure out what works for you.
closing: Every stylist at Premier Salon runs their own book and brings their own focus to the chair — see the team page for who specializes in what.
